headline: Scaling your startup at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
standfirst: Learn how to turn your prototype into a real product with industry experts.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: TechCrunch announced a new workshop series at Disrupt 2026 focused on scaling startups.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Founders often struggle to move from early prototypes to full production models.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: Experts from Foxglove, MBRYONICS, and Bedrock Robotics will share their scaling blueprints.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Register by September 25 to secure your spot and save up to $200 on your ticket.

caption:
TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is hosting workshops to help startup founders take their prototypes to production.

Scaling a business is notoriously difficult. This event connects founders with leaders from companies like Bedrock Robotics to learn the actual process of growth. You can save $200 if you sign up before the September 25 deadline.
